role: Senior Front-End Developer · UI/UX Designer · Tech Lead

summary.heading: Professional Summary
summary.body: Front-end developer with 5+ years building scalable web and mobile interfaces, currently leading the front-end of a large-scale public-health streaming platform. I work end to end — from Figma prototypes to production React/Next.js code — combining strong engineering with a designer's eye for usability. Italian citizen based in Sicily; fluent in Portuguese, English and Italian, comfortable in remote, multicultural teams.

jobs.role: Senior Front-End Developer & Tech Lead — Capgemini
bullets: Lead the front-end of LIVE, a streaming platform for the Portuguese Ministry of Health, built in React, Next.js and TypeScript.
Architected a styled component library on top of MUI and implemented WebRTC (Kurento) real-time streaming.
Acted as UI/UX designer, producing Figma prototypes from inception, and led a small front-end team using Agile/Scrum and Jira.
Developed government systems: SCOT (traffic-ticketing) in Ionic + React and SIARL, a coastal-resource management platform in React/Next.js + Redux.
Delivered data-driven UI, responsive layouts and UX refinement cycles; designed the SIARL Figma prototype from the start.
Built mobile and web features for the MEUPET app with Ionic, Angular and Firebase, including a geolocation-based lost & found and a pet nutrition BMI calculator.

jobs.role: Web Developer — Agência Zum · Atitude Comunicação · Freelance
bullets: Delivered full-stack web and mobile projects with PHP, JavaScript, Ionic and Angular — campaign sites with back-offices, systems analysis and databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL).
